summary: character-ai-sdk ships obfuscated auto-executed loader with VM-detection native addon
details: The package's advertised main (index.mjs) re-exports from personas.mjs, which top-level imports cssVarMap from./cache-warm.mjs and invokes it in a loop at module load. cache-warm.mjs is a ~290 KB single-line file whose body is a base64/XOR-encoded string-array with hex-mangled identifiers (_0x1f1382d8[...]) — an obfuscator.io loader pattern. Identical obfuscation shape appears in sibling files cache-sweep.mjs, build-cache.mjs, and workspaces.js (all declared in package.json 'files'). Token scans of cache-sweep.mjs and build-cache.mjs show accesses consistent with child-process and host/exit sinks (.pid,.host,.exit,.search) on obfuscated locals. The package also ships platform-specific native addons at native/{linux,darwin,win32}/{x64,arm64}/cache-probe.node whose symbols (_ZN2VM..., _ZN8VMDetect10VMDetectorC2..., VMDetectWorker) and attribution file (LICENSE-node-vm-detect.txt) identify them as the VMAware VM-detection library exposed via N-API. A character-AI SDK has no advertised need for VM detection; pairing opaque loader siblings auto-executed at import with a VM-detector addon is the structural shape of a sandbox-evasion stealth loader that gates its payload on non-VM hosts. Importing or requiring character-ai-sdk executes the obfuscated loader with no user action.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
